description: Free. Mints a new namespace_token and immediately invalidates the current one, which you must present to authorize the rotation. Do this whenever the token may have been exposed — a leaked token is otherwise permanent, unrevocable read and delete access to every secret in the namespace. There is no recovery if you lose the token. This tool is free; no payment is required.

namespace_token.description: One-time token issued by the first call that claimed this namespace. Required for every later call.

name: vault_rotate_token

namespace_token.description: The new token, shown exactly once. The previous one stops working.

notice.description: Human-readable warning that the old token is now invalid

title: Rotate a vault namespace token
